player_prompt.intro:
Woezɔe be Lights Out! Alesi {size}x{size} ƒe ŋgɔdzi be dzadzra.
Aʋa nuwɔwɔ be yɔ dzadzra katã GBƆGBƆ (si be dzadzra le '.')
Ne aɖɔ dzadzra a de, evɔ eŋgɔ dzi eye wòdzi katã eƒe dzadzra siwo le eŋgɔ ŋu (dzi/ɣa/me/ke).
Dze [row col] be aɖɔ dzadzra (0-ƒe aɖɔdzɔ, eye wòdzi siwo le 0-{max_index}).
Alesi {max_turns} aɖɔdzɔwo be aƒe dzadzra ƒe ŋgɔdzi.
Nuŋlɔ: 'O' = dzadzra do, '.' = dzadzra gbɔgbɔ

board.current_state:
Dɔwɔlawo ɖe ɖo (Kɔkɔ {moves_made}, {moves_left} ɖo le esi, {completion}% ɖo na):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aɖaɖa ɖe ɖe na ɖe [row col] si, eye row kple col le integers 0 kple {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɔɔrdinatɛ siwo nye be wo le akɔɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu 0 kple {max_index}. Woŋdɔ [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Aƒekpe! Awoe xɔe dzadzra sia le {moves_used} ŋdɔdzidziwo!
